## What you need

- **Must (headline):** Robotics fundamentals, C++, Python (production), Perception / computer vision, Simulation & sim-to-real, ROS.
- **Important (headline):** Robot learning & VLA models, Edge inference, Teleoperation data pipelines, Safety cases.
- **Full inventory:** 42 skills (Must 6 · Important 14 · Should 18 · Optional 4), each with its evidence and posting keywords: [physical-ai-engineer.md](../../03-skills-and-tech/inventories/physical-ai-engineer.md).
- **Prerequisites:** Robotics or controls background with ML
- What to learn first and what to drop across roles: [skills radar](../../03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md); in what order: [learning roadmaps](../../03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md).

## How to prove it

- **What the evidence asks for:** A sim-to-real or manipulation project with measured success rates and failure analysis
- **Project archetypes that cover the most of its Must and Important skills** (Grade M): [P16 Sim-to-real robotics project](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p16) (85%); [P8 Paper re-implementation with rigorous evals and a write-up](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p8) (12%); [P7 Small-scale distributed training / post-training study](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p7) (12%). One project rarely covers a role; the [job-search strategy](../../06-job-search/job-search-strategy.md#the-constraints-that-bind-first) computes the smallest sets that do.
- How verifiable the proof must be, and what to publish: [proof-of-work standards](../../05-portfolio/proof-of-work-standards.md).
